task.title: Rename roadmap mutation tool to codewiki_roadmap
task.summary: Rename the internal roadmap mutation tool from codewiki_task to codewiki_roadmap across registration, schemas, skills, docs, and tests without keeping a backward-compatible alias.

goal.outcome: Agents use codewiki_roadmap as the only internal roadmap mutation tool name, matching task/sprint/checkpoint/archive responsibilities.
acceptance: Pi tool registration exposes codewiki_roadmap and no longer exposes codewiki_task.
Skills/docs/tests use codewiki_roadmap for tasks, sprints, checkpoints, close/cancel, and archive roadmap mutations.
No backward-compatible codewiki_task alias remains in live tool registration.
Typecheck, smoke, feature, and package dry-run checks pass.
non_goals: Do not preserve codewiki_task as an alias.
Do not rename canonical roadmap files.
verification: search proves no live codewiki_task tool references except historical artifacts if unavoidable.

delta.desired: Internal roadmap mutation tool is named codewiki_roadmap without compatibility shim.
delta.current: Internal roadmap mutation tool is named codewiki_task despite sprint/checkpoint/archive responsibilities.
delta.closure: Close after code, docs, skills, schemas, and tests agree on codewiki_roadmap and validation passes.
